summary.text: Sean Graves is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 6, a two-seat district, in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Zachary Nutting; they face incumbent Democrats Paul Berch and Cathryn A. Harvey.

paragraphs.text: Sean Graves advanced from the Republican primary for Cheshire 6 on September 8, 2026.
He was also a Republican candidate for Cheshire 6 in 2024, when Paul Berch and Cathryn A. Harvey defeated him and Bob Sutherland in the general election.
